summary: Tests one visibility bit per plane sub-block from a bitstream and ORs a mask into caller-supplied 16-bit visibility bitfield output words. Uses a decode-state object (this+0x194) holding a bit accumulator, bit count, and a block counter, plus a bitstream reader helper that refills on exhaustion. Writes a bit into each output word when the corresponding bit is set, then persists the decode state.

operations.description: Load decode state: v3 = a1[101] (pointer to bit-decode state, this+0x194) and v18 = 1 << a1[93] (output mask built from the shift count at this+0x174).

Guard guard:0: when a1[63] (this+0xFC) is zero the counter-reset path is skipped; otherwise, when the block counter v3[13] (this+0x1C8) is zero, call CounterUpdateWithZero (0x0051AEFC) to reset counters, returning 0 if the reset fails.
Guard guard:1: when the plane-bit count a1[79] (this+0x13C) is <= 0, the per-plane loop is skipped entirely.

Snapshot stream and counter state: v11/v12 from a1[5] (buffer pointer at this+0x14 and trailing word at this+0x18), v13 = a1[94] (this+0x178 counter), v7 = v3[4] (bit accumulator, this+0x1A4), v8 = v3[5] (bit count, this+0x1A8).

Loop v19 from 0 while v19 < a1[79] (this+0x13C): load the output word pointer v9 = a2 + 4*v19; when the bit count v8 < 1 refill through sub_51A794 (0x0051A794), returning 0 on failure; then test the current bit ((v7 >> --v8) & 1) and OR the mask v18 into *v9 when the bit is set.

Persist state on exit: restore a1[5] and a1[5]+4 (this+0x14, this+0x18) from v11/v12, a1[94] (this+0x178) from v13, decrement the block counter v3[13] (this+0x1C8), and store v7/v8 back into v3[4]/v3[5] (this+0x1A4, this+0x1A8).
Return 1 on success; return 0 only when the counter reset or a bitstream refill fails.
